# opencode-greenbrain

OpenCode plugin that adds:

- the **GreenBrain** provider with the **GreenBrain Auto** model (`greenbrain/auto`),
- the **GreenBrain MCP** server (`tools.greenbrain.*`),
- Energy/Cost sections in the right sidebar,
- last-model + session reduction percentages in the TUI footer.

The plugin registers the provider and MCP server itself, so `opencode.json` only
needs one plugin entry.

## Install

Published package:

```jsonc title="opencode.json"
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": [
    {
      "package": "opencode-greenbrain",
      "options": {
        "baseUrl": "https://ai.greenbrainscience.com",
        "apiKeyFile": "~/.config/opencode/greenbrain-mcp-key"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

`baseUrl` is optional and defaults to `https://ai.greenbrainscience.com`.

Provide the key with one of:

```jsonc
"options": {
  "baseUrl": "https://ai.greenbrainscience.com",
  "apiKeyFile": "~/.config/opencode/greenbrain-mcp-key"
}
```

```jsonc
"options": {
  "baseUrl": "https://ai.greenbrainscience.com",
  "apiKey": "{env:GREENBRAIN_API_KEY}"
}
```

The plugin also checks `GREENBRAIN_API_KEY`, `GREENBRAIN_MCP_KEY`, and
`HIILICHAT_MCP_KEY`, plus the default key file
`~/.config/opencode/greenbrain-mcp-key`.

## Local development

Until the package is published, copy it into the project:

```sh
mkdir -p .opencode/plugins/greenbrain
cp opencode-greenbrain/src/index.ts .opencode/plugins/greenbrain/index.ts
cp opencode-greenbrain/src/tui.tsx .opencode/plugins/greenbrain/tui.tsx
```

It then loads automatically. Do not also list it in `plugins`, or it will load
twice.

## Requirements

The backend must serve both:

```text
GET  /v1/models
POST /v1/chat/completions
POST /mcp
```

Verify the API with:

```sh
curl -s https://ai.greenbrainscience.com/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat ~/.config/opencode/greenbrain-mcp-key)"
```

It must return JSON, not the web app's HTML. If it returns HTML, the `/v1`
routes are not deployed on that host yet.

## Publish

```sh
cd opencode-greenbrain
npm publish --access public
```

After publishing, `"plugins": ["opencode-greenbrain"]` resolves from npm.
